root_causes.semantic_bug: A cast to nullable owning type did not transfer an existing temporary owner, so return lowering classified the nullable result as borrowed and retained it again.

root_causes.semantic_bug: The same missing nullable Cast classification failed to acquire a borrowed nullable class value, leaving no temporary owner for constructor-argument cleanup.

root_causes.implementation_primitive: MoveInit source reset now requires both needs_destroy and supports_default
